{{Quote|Our father was killed in the Clone Wars, and Mom died a few years later. We had no other relatives and no friends. It was this or starve to death.|[[Tavia Kitik]]|<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>}}
This [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was the '''mother''' of [[Bink Kitik|Bink]] and [[Tavia Kitik]]. Her [[Bink Kitik's father|husband]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and she died a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, leaving Bink and Tavia as orphans by the age of ten.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
